description: This file defines the PayGradeConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface for configuring menu screens related to pay grades in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the screen to 'viewPayGrades' within the admin menu context.

classes.name: PayGradeConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for the Pay Grade menu in the admin module, sets the screen to 'viewPayGrades'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the screen for the pay grades menu item by overriding it to 'viewPayGrades'.
